voice.text: Quick quiz! Which country drinks the most coffee per person? Brazil, Finland, or Italy? It's Finland: about twelve kilos each, every year.

scenes.question: Which country drinks the most coffee per person?
scenes.explain: About 12 kg per person, every year.

voice.text: Legend says a goat herder called Kaldi saw his goats dancing after eating red berries. He took them to a monastery, and the monks brewed the first coffee.

facts.text: Saw his goats dance after eating red berries
Took the berries to a monastery
The monks brewed the first coffee

voice.text: Monks in Yemen drank it in the 1400s. Istanbul opened a coffee house in 1554, England followed around 1650, and instant coffee arrived in 1938.

items.label: 1400s
items.title: Yemen
items.text: Monks drink it to stay awake

voice.text: Today the Nordics lead: Finland, then Norway, Iceland and Denmark.
Myth: coffee dehydrates you. Actually, a normal cup hydrates you almost as well as water.

back.label: Fact
back.text: A normal cup hydrates you almost as well as water.

voice.text: Crema: the golden foam on top of a fresh espresso. No crema? Your beans are probably stale.

scenes.text: The golden foam on top of a fresh espresso.
scenes.example: No crema? Your beans are probably stale.

voice.text: About sixty percent of the world's coffee is Arabica. The rest is mostly Robusta.
And the biggest growers? Colombia, Vietnam, and by far, Brazil.
As the Turkish proverb says: a cup of coffee commits one to forty years of friendship.

scenes.text: A cup of coffee commits one to forty years of friendship.
scenes.author: Turkish proverb
